title: Grandma Linux — User manual
prompt: Select a task. Close the page to return to this list.
back: Select OK to return to the task list.

topics.title: Open an application
topics.before: Use the menu to find all applications.
steps: Select the menu button at the bottom left.
topics.tip: To use a desktop icon, double-click it.

topics.title: Find your files
steps: Select a folder in the left panel.
topics.result: The file opens in an application.
topics.tip: Downloads contains downloaded files. Pictures contains your photos. Documents contains your documents.

topics.title: Save a document
topics.before: Use Documents to write a document. Use Notepad for a short note.
topics.tip: Keep the file extension that the application supplies.

topics.title: Use the internet and WhatsApp
topics.before: These applications need an internet connection.
steps: Select the address bar at the top.
topics.tip: To use WhatsApp, open its desktop icon. Follow the instructions to connect your phone.

topics.title: View photos or a PDF
steps: Select Pictures or the folder that contains your file.
Double-click the photo or PDF file.
topics.result: Photos opens photos. PDF opens PDF documents.
topics.tip: To watch a video or listen to music, double-click the file in Files.

topics.title: Receive files from a phone
topics.before: The phone also needs LocalSend. Connect both devices to the same Wi-Fi network.
steps: Open Send Files on the computer.
Select the files to send on the phone.
Select this computer as the destination.
Accept the files on the computer, if asked.
topics.result: The transfer screen shows when the transfer is complete.
topics.tip: Use the transfer screen to open the received files. You do not need a cable.

topics.title: Take a screenshot
steps: Select the screenshot tool in its window or tray menu.
Select the copy or save button.
topics.tip: If asked, allow screen capture. The Print Screen key depends on the configured shortcut.

topics.title: Translate a short text
steps: Select the source language on the left.
Select the translation language on the right.
Enter or paste a short text in the left field.
topics.result: The translation appears in the right field.
topics.tip: Read the translation before you use it. Some Portuguese translations can use words from Portugal.

topics.title: Look up a word
topics.before: Dictionary translates words. Use Translator for a sentence.
steps: Select a dictionary for the required languages.
topics.result: The installed dictionary works without internet.
topics.tip: Select the correct direction. Portuguese to English differs from English to Portuguese.

topics.title: Use maps without internet
topics.before: Portugal maps are installed. Other regions need a download first.
steps: Enlarge the map to see roads and places.
topics.result: Downloaded regions are available without internet.
topics.tip: Without location information, the map might not show your current position. Enter a place in the search field to find it.

topics.title: Make a backup
topics.before: A backup is a saved copy of your personal files.
steps: Check the date of the last successful backup.
topics.result: The new copy contains Desktop, Documents, Downloads and Pictures.
topics.tip: Monthly copies need the computer on with your session open. This local copy does not include the installed system.

topics.title: Recover files
topics.result: A new folder opens with the recovered files. Your current files stay unchanged.
topics.tip: To use a saved backup from another installation, select Open a saved backup folder.

topics.title: Keep a copy before reinstalling
topics.before: A backup on this disk is also lost if you erase the disk.
steps: Copy the entire folder to another storage location.
Keep its recovery key with the saved copy.
topics.result: The saved folder contains the repository, recovery key and recovery instructions.
topics.tip: Keep this folder private. Ask for help before you reinstall the system.

topics.title: Update the computer
steps: Open Updates from System. Select System and applications.
topics.tip: Use the normal restart option. Keep the power connected during updates. For the Grandma Linux manual and setup, select Grandma Linux setup and manual in Updates.

topics.title: Ask for help
steps: Select Support information to view the computer information.
Give this information to the person who helps you.
topics.result: The information stays on the computer until you share it.
topics.tip: To allow remote help, select Remote support in Help. Share the temporary password only with your helper. Close Remote Support when finished. For larger text, open System → Reading comfort. Choose 12 or 14 pt; restore the previous font there if needed.

topics.title: Turn off the computer
steps: Open the menu at the bottom left.
topics.tip: Use Restart when you want the computer to start again.
